title: 多要了一碗面
scene: A customer and a noodle shop owner sort out an order that arrived twice.

segments.speaker: 小林
segments.text: 老板，我刚才点了一碗牛肉面。
segments.text_en: Boss, I ordered a bowl of beef noodles just now.

segments.speaker: 老板
segments.text_en: Right, it's already been taken over to you.

segments.speaker: 小林
segments.text: 问题是，桌上现在有两碗。
segments.text_en: The problem is, there are two bowls on the table now.

segments.speaker: 老板
segments.text_en: Two bowls? Let me look at the order slip.

segments.speaker: 小林
segments.text_en: I can only manage one bowl, honestly.

segments.speaker: 老板
segments.text: 不好意思，我们写了两次。你不用付第二碗的钱。
segments.text_en: Sorry, we wrote it down twice. You don't have to pay for the second bowl.

segments.speaker: 小林
segments.text: 那太不好意思了。要不我带回家吧？
segments.text_en: That's really too kind. How about I take it home then?

segments.speaker: 老板
segments.text: 好啊，我给你打包。晚上热一下就行。
segments.text_en: Sure, I'll pack it up for you. Just heat it up in the evening.

segments.speaker: 小林
segments.text_en: Thanks, boss, I'll come again next time.

segments.speaker: 老板
segments.text_en: Take care, be careful on the way.

glossary.gloss: bowl; also the measure word for bowls of food
to pack up, to take away

grammar_spotlights.explanation: 碗 works as the measure word here: number plus measure word plus noun, never number plus noun alone.

grammar_spotlights.excerpt: 我刚才点了一碗牛肉面
grammar_spotlights.explanation: 了 after the verb marks the ordering as a completed action.

questions.question: 小林遇到了什么问题？
questions.explanation: He says there are two bowls on the table when he only ordered one.

questions.question: 问题是怎么发生的？
questions.explanation: The owner admits 我们写了两次, they wrote the order down twice.

questions.question: 第二碗面最后怎么处理？
questions.explanation: Xiao Lin suggests taking it home and the owner packs it up.

questions.question: 老板对小林的态度怎么样？
questions.explanation: He apologises, waives the charge, packs the food, and wishes him a safe trip home.
